finding: scope-lint:10 calls itself a pre-commit hook, but no hook, validate script or skill runs it. This repository holds 46 scope errors that nothing reports. Fix: Add scope-lint to the factory hooks and to the validate skill, after the existing errors are fixed or baselined.
why_this_severity: No hook or `validate` gate runs `scope-lint`, although its header names a pre-commit hook, so 77 scope errors go unreported. The contract in `interface-contracts.md` requires no hook, and a person can run the script by hand (no to fails_purpose).
